description:
Idempotently install (or normalize) a single cron schedule that fires `service_interface::session_ledger_service::summarize_quiescent_sessions` every `cadence_minutes` minutes. Mirrors `ensure_periodic_poll_schedule` for the M6 auto-summarize path: clears any existing schedules tagged `ledger:periodic_summarize`, then creates one fresh schedule with the requested cadence.

Boot-only — wired via the profile's `starting_actions` so a fresh solet starts summarizing her own sessions the moment her services come up. The `is_discoverable=False` flag keeps the verb out of the model's `process_search` results; operator-initiated re-runs go through the operator bridge directly.

Fails fast if scheduling_service is not bound at session_ledger_service construction. Summaries auto-flow on quiescence; no external observer agent required.
embedding_description: Boot-time idempotent helper that installs a single cron firing summarize_quiescent_sessions every N minutes. Mirrors ensure_periodic_poll_schedule. Tag: ledger:periodic_summarize. Default cadence 10 minutes.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Periodic auto-summarize schedule status — created, already_present, or normalized after duplicate cleanup.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The ledger now auto-summarizes quiescent sessions every configured interval. If you are diagnosing whether summaries are landing, check session_ledger__session.summary_text after the next firing rather than re-running this verb.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Ensuring a single periodic auto-summarize cron schedule for the LLM session ledger
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: RuntimeError: scheduling_service not bound (profile omits scheduling). ValueError: cadence_minutes out of the 1..59 range. SchedulerError: scheduling backend rejected the cron expression or refused to clear/create the schedule.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If scheduling is unavailable, the operator can invoke summarize_quiescent_sessions directly from the operator bridge as a one-shot. If cadence validation failed, retry with a value in [1, 59].
